description: This file defines a class 'CachedCatalogViewModelService' that implements caching for catalog-related data retrieval, such as brands, catalog items, and types, in an e-commerce web application.

classes.name: CachedCatalogViewModelService
classes.description: A service class that caches results for catalog data retrieval to improve performance and reduce redundant data fetching in an e-commerce web application.

methods.name: GetBrands
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the list of brands from cache or fetches and caches it if not present.

methods.name: GetCatalogItems
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves catalog items with paging and filtering options from cache or fetches and caches it if not present.

methods.name: GetTypes
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the list of catalog types from cache or fetches and caches it if not present.
